i-reference/clients/replace-a-clients-servers.md): Replaces the client's required and optional saved-server attachments without ro
und-tripping the whole config. Composed server-side from the client's current config, so every other setting is preserved, and `ex
pectedConfigId` is required so two concurrent server replacements cannot silently lose one.\n- [Duplicate a client](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/clients/duplicate-a-client.md): Creates a new client carrying the selected client's current config, and re
sponds `201` with the copy's detail. Purely additive: the source is untouched.\n- [Validate a server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/server-diagnostics/validate-a-server.md): Connects to the server, initializes the MCP session, and returns a connection
snapshot (server info, negotiated capabilities). The same check the hosted inspector runs when you connect a server.\n- [Run the d
octor](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/run-the-doctor.md): Runs the full doctor workflow (probe → connect
→ initialize → capabilities → primitives) and returns a step-by-step report. The richest signal for \"is this server healthy, and
why not.\"\n- [Check OAuth requirement](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-diagnostics/check-oauth-requirement.md): Lig
htweight, no MCP connection: reports whether the server is configured to require an OAuth grant.\n- [List tools](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/primitives/list-tools.md): Returns the server's tools as a collection page. Each item is the MCP tool definit
ion (`name`, `description`, `inputSchema`, ...).\n- [List prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-prompts.m
d): Returns the server's prompts as a collection page.\n- [List resources](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-r
esources.md): Returns the server's resources as a collection page.\n- [Read a resource](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/prim
itives/read-a-resource.md): Reads a single resource by URI and returns its contents.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/primitives/list-server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the MCP skills extensi
on (SEP-2640), including skills it advertises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-side, bec
ause duplicate detection spans the whole listing.\n- [Get a server skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/get-a-s
erver-skill.md): Fetches one skill by URI and verifies it before returning a byte: the SKILL.md digest against the manifest, the f
etched frontmatter against what the listing advertised, and the name against the URI. Reaches skills a partial listing never menti
oned. When a check fails the response carries a `refusal`…\n- [Read a server skill's supporting file](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/primitives/read-a-server-skills-supporting-file.md): Reads one supporting file belonging to a skill, checking its byte l
ength and digest against the skill's own manifest. The manifest is the read allowlist and is re-fetched here rather than accepted
from the caller, so a request cannot authorize its own read.\n- [Export a server snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
xport/export-a-server-snapshot.md): Lists tools, resources, and prompts in one call and returns a single JSON snapshot: handy for
diffing a server's surface over time in CI.\n- [Call a tool](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/call-a-tool.md): Exec
utes a tool on the server and returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs` (wall-clock time of `executeTool`). T
ool-level failures (`isError: true` in the result) are **successful calls**: the server answered; only transport/auth errors use t
he error envelope.\n- [Render a prompt](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-a-prompt.md): Renders a prompt with
arguments and returns the MCP `GetPromptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [Render an MCP App widget headlessly](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call an MCP App tool and mount its `ui://`
widget in real headless Chromium running the production host bridge, then report whether it rendered, what it logged, what it was
blocked from fetching, and the widget as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n- [Create a retained widget session](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that cr
eated the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject,
project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its App in one local Chromium context.…\n- [
Read a retained widget snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.md): Available on
ly on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session
is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Returns an accessibility tree and address
able elements without replay…\n- [Act on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/act-on-a-retained-widg
et.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or
API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one coordinate a
ction with fresh project/server authorization.\n- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/run
-a-retained-widget-step.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requir
es a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout.
Runs one semantic action or assertion, using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/execution/close-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hos
ted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server an
d expires after its idle timeout. Disposes the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List a suite's settin
gs history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit to
the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs were launched agains
t it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumbe
r` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-envir
onment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.\n- [Li
st a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this serve
r signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accounts. Anoth
er member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.\n- [Get a server account](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Another member's personal acco
unt answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_ambiguous
\"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-acco
unts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-fo
rmed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the ac
count.\n- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the
